title: Mazenchu Anime Posts Opening Video Narrated by Actress First Summer Uika
content: The staff for the television anime of TORCH 's Mazenchu character brand announced on Wednesday that actress First Summer Uika is providing the anime's opening narration. title: Sumikko Gurashi Franchise Gets 5th Anime Film in 2027
content: San-X 's Sumikko Gurashi franchise announced on Wednesday that it will release a fifth anime film in 2027. The announcement did not reveal the film's title, but presented a visual drawn by creator Yuri Yokomizo and hinted that the film's story will center on the character Neko as the protagonist.
author: ANN

title: Major Shonen Jump Series Reveals First Look at Final Release After 5 Years
content: Launched in 1968, Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump eventually became the best-selling manga magazine of all time. Over the decades, the magazine has serialized hundreds of series, but not all of them managed to make their mark in history.
author: ComicBook

title: Marvel, Kadokawa Unveil More Art, Story Details for Spider-Man, Spider-Gwen Manga
content: Kadokawa unveiled more details about its partnership with Marvel Comics on Wednesday, including more concept art and some story details for their upcoming Spider-Man and Spider-Gwen manga. Tokitokoro ( Jeff the Land Shark ) is working on Spider-Man.
author: ANN

title: Kuri Hime Ayakashi Yobanashi Manga Ends on October 28
content: The November issue of Ichijinsha 's Monthly Comic Zero-Sum magazine announced on Monday that Anko Chōchin's Kuri Hime Ayakashi Yobanashi , the manga adaptation of Hyuganatsu 's novel series of the same title, will end in the magazine's next issue on October 28.
author: ANN

title: Manga Plus Adds Digimon Eggs Manga on October 2
content: The Digimon franchise announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Tuesday that Shueisha 's MANGA Plus platform will add Ayumu Minato's Digimon Eggs manga as a simulpub title on October 2. The series will launch in Shueisha 's Saikyō Jump magazine on the same day.

title: Katsuwo Launches Manga Adaptation of Renren Ii's Ōja no Ban Kuruwase Shōgi Novels
content: Manga creator Katsuwo launched a manga adaptation of Renren Ii's Ōja no Ban Kuruwase: Net Shōgi no Teiō, Real Taikai de Chōjō o Mezasu ( Underdog Upsets the King ) light novels in the November issue of Kadokawa 's Dengeki Daioh G on Monday. The issue's front cover will also feature the manga.
